data.description:
## Goal
Update sprint SKILL.md Phase E to call check-story-handoff.sh before dispatching each successor story sub-agent. Non-PASS predecessor verdict blocks successor dispatch.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md: in Phase E story batch dispatch, before each story dispatch call check-story-handoff.sh for that story's predecessor (when one exists); exit 1 or 2 -> skip dispatch, add to blocked list

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -c 'check-story-handoff' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md should be at least 1
- bash tests/scripts/test-check-story-handoff.sh exits 0 (still GREEN)

## Testing Mode
GREEN (instruction file update; depends S3/T2)
